rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically shaking with rapid small movements.

example.english: I can feel my phone vibrate under the pillow.
example.traditional: 我隔住個枕頭都感覺到部手機震。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaak3 zyu6 go3 zam2 tau4 dou1 gam2 gok3 dou3 bou6 sau2 gei1 zan3

rows.note: Use this when a song, idea, or experience resonates with people or strikes an emotional chord.

example.english: This song can vibrate through the crowd and strike an emotional chord; everyone says it is great.
example.traditional: 呢首歌好容易引起共鳴，個個聽完都話正。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 hou2 jung4 ji6 jan5 hei2 gung6 ming4 go3 go3 ting1 jyun4 dou1 waa6 zeng3

rows.note: Use this when someone is emotionally stirred up or full of excitement, rather than when something resonates with an audience.

example.english: I vibrate with excitement when I hear this news.
example.traditional: 我一聽到呢個消息就好激動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 hou2 gik1 dung6
